_meta: Canonical English catalog. Holds every translatable string in the core; tr.json is a full mirror. Missing keys in any other locale fall back to these values (per-key). Contract tokens (VERDICT: PASS/FAIL, DISSENT:, PASS/FAIL, risk class names, JSON field names, CLI arg/command names, the ⚠ glyph and fixed [LABEL] marker prefixes) are matched by machine and stay literal — only the variable prose is translated.
advisory_mode: Advisory mode: fewer than 2 independent providers; cross-verification disabled, confidence capped at 0.6, output marked unverified.
prompts.plan:
Task: {task}
Give your own independent plan/answer: steps, assumptions, risks. Be short and concrete.

cli.enable.explainer:
Autocapture distills past sessions into the append-only audit, unattended.
Before it runs, EVERY captured payload passes the PHI/secret fail-safe gate
(Article 4 & 13): tool I/O and base64 blobs included. Capture is OFF by default.
